problem.description: P9-02 dh-audit found an architecture diagram ambiguity and a flaky immediate WebKit answer visibility assertion.
symptoms: First A22 SVG placed SRAM and peripherals outside the RP2040 chip boundary and visually connected them in series with board flash
WebKit target QA failed one immediate answer-content visibility check on A19 although isolated 320/390/430 px reproduction passed

investigation.root_cause: A22 diagram geometry confused chip-level ownership and bus branches. Browser check queried visibility immediately after a click without waiting for a rendered visible state.
sources_checked: Raspberry Pi Pico board datasheet section 1 and Figure 1 Rev3
Raspberry Pi RP2040 datasheet section 2.6.2 and Raspberry Pi Pico board documentation
Espressif ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1 v1.2 user guide Hardware Revision Details
MicroPython RP2 quick reference and machine.Pin API

changes: Redrew A22 so CPU0/CPU1, bus, SRAM and peripherals are inside RP2040 while 2 MB QSPI flash is outside the chip but on the Pico board
Connected CPU0 to the bus and kept separate branches to SRAM, peripherals and flash; visually rendered the final SVG
Changed targeted browser QA to wait for answer-content.visible, then reran all 24 advanced lessons at three mobile widths in Chromium and WebKit
resolution.remaining: No board or compiler/firmware run, physical GPIO/ADC/radio measurement, or exact DevKitC PW-batch schematic has been verified. No confirmed P0/P1 remains in the published digital/table scope.
